verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs say traces can be filtered, exported, shared and compared via the API as well as the UI. They also document official Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs (with a public SDK repo) and an official MCP server, so programmatic control is a first-party capability. However, the pack contains no API reference, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so the breadth of the public API surface beyond tracing is unproven. Missing for 10: a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, evidence that datasets, evaluations, alerts and dashboards are API-drivable, and hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
